name: Artificial turf install
summary: Synthetic grass priced from lawn area, roll waste, crushed-rock base, sod demo, infill, seams and nails.

items.label: Demo existing sod and dump it
items.source: hoursPerSqFtDemo 0.006 (index.html / suggestedTurfKit landscape); dump $18/ton (dumpPerTon) x 2 in sod at SOD_LB_PER_CF 75 = 0.00625 t/sq ft (calc.mjs sodTons, sodDepthIn default 2)

items.label: Crushed-rock base, 3 in, with geotextile
items.source: hoursPerSqFtBase 0.007; 3 in base at CRUSHED_LB_PER_CF 100 = 0.0125 t/sq ft x gravelPerTon $32 = $0.40, plus geotextilePerSqFt $0.18 (index.html defaults, calc.mjs baseTons)

items.label: Install landscape turf (10% roll waste)
items.source: hoursPerSqFtInstall 0.011 and turfPerSqFt $2.15, both applied to bought turf = lawn x 1.10 (wastePercent 10, calc.mjs turfBuySqFt)

items.label: Perimeter nails
items.source: perimeterLf 100; nailsPerLf 3 x nailEach $0.11 (index.html defaults); the specialist has no separate perimeter labor rate

items.label: Travel, plate compactor, dump trailer
items.source: travelAndEquipment $275 (index.html default), a flat job cost in calculateBid
